spells.name: Dwarf's Bell
spells.story: A tiny forest dweller with grass on his body and a bell on his arm, who lures hunters off the path.

spells.name: Forest Dwarf's Hex
spells.story: A small hairy forest dweller with backward feet who steals the unwary's rice.

spells.name: Wandering Ghost
spells.story: A restless ghost that wanders the forest paths and chills those who meet it.

spells.name: Wild Folk's Howl
spells.source: Malagasy folklore (Sibree, The Great African Island)
spells.story: The wild folk of the Malagasy forests, who live apart and are feared by travellers.

spells.name: Eel's Bite
spells.story: A giant eel of the Hawaiian pools, whose bite is quick and whose coils are strong.

spells.name: Night-Builders' Stones
spells.story: The small people of the old valleys, who build in a night and are shy of the day.

spells.name: Mist-Folk's Song
spells.story: Pale mist-folk of the mountains, who sing in the fog and lead travellers astray.

spells.name: Whale's Wake
spells.story: The great whale stolen by Kae in the Maori tale, who struck back from the deep.

spells.name: Vui's Wile
spells.story: A spirit of the Banks Islands tales, who lurks in the bush and tricks the careless.

spells.name: Eye-Footed Ogre
spells.story: An ogre with eyes in the soles of his feet, who must lie down to see.

spells.name: Veld Ogre's Maw
spells.story: Cannibal ogres of the Zulu tales, who hunt the unwary of the lonely veld.

spells.boss_name: Dodo the Bogey of the Bush
spells.name: Bush Bogey
spells.story: A bogey of the Hausa bush who frightens children and wanderers alike.

spells.name: Gizo's Snare
spells.story: The scheming spider of the Hausa tales, who talks his way into any trap he sets.

spells.name: Thief-Priest's Ruse
spells.story: The priest who stole Tinirau's whale and ate it, and was hunted for the theft.

spells.name: Sea Elder's Pull
spells.story: A sea-creature with a human head and a fish's body, who draws in swimmers with its tubular tongue.

spells.name: Lizard Beast's Bite
spells.story: A giant lizard of Maori legend, whose bite is venom and whose hide is armour.

spells.name: Songomby's Shape
spells.source: Malagasy folklore (Sibree, The Great African Island)
spells.story: A creature of the Malagasy tales that takes many shapes to lure travellers into the wild.

spells.name: Ogress's Cage
spells.story: An ogress of the Berber tales, who lures children to her cave.

spells.name: Giant Bird's Wing
spells.source: Malagasy folklore (Sibree, The Great African Island)
spells.story: A monstrous bird of the Malagasy tales, which makes nests of ships.

spells.name: Lightning Bird
spells.story: A great black-and-white bird said to call down the lightning and the storm.

spells.name: Kataore's Wing
spells.story: A winged flying monster of the Pacific tales, which carries off the unwary.

spells.name: Two-Faced Hunger
spells.story: A monster with a handsome face in front and a hyena's jaws behind, who lures the traveller.

spells.name: Wild Man's Club
spells.story: The wild men of the mountain forests, with long nails, who live in caves.

spells.name: River Dragon
spells.story: A dragon of the Gambian river banks, said to be long, scaled and horse-headed.

spells.name: Taniwha's Pool
spells.story: A water monster who lurked in a pool and was slain by a clever visitor.

spells.name: Ogre's Weight
spells.story: A great ogre of the Berber tales, who is outwitted by the quick.

spells.name: Ogre's Hunger
spells.story: An ogre of the Swahili tales, who tricks children into lifting up a basket.

spells.name: Hopping Half
spells.story: A creature with half a body that hops on one leg and runs faster than a hunter.

spells.name: Taniwha's Hunger
spells.story: A taniwha of the Maori tales, an old lake monster who preyed on the people near the water.

spells.name: Storm Serpent
spells.story: A great serpent said to live in the falls and to ride the storm when it rises.

spells.boss_name: Kalamainu'u the Lizard of the Pool
spells.name: Pool Lizard
spells.story: The great mo'o of the Hawaiian tales, a lizard of the pools who snaps at bathers.

spells.name: Dog-Man's Hunger
spells.story: An ogre of the old stories, half dog, who roams the dark and takes children.

spells.name: Serpent's Deep
spells.story: The water serpent of the Mwindo epic, which draws the hero into the depths.

spells.name: Dawn Dread
spells.story: A sea-people who live under the waves, who cannot bear the light of day.

spells.name: Giant Eagle's Strike
spells.story: The giant bird of the southern mountains, said to snatch children from the ground.

spells.name: Shaggy Giant's Fist
spells.story: A hairy giant of the old Malagasy stories, who crushes with both fists.

spells.name: Great Serpent's Coil
spells.story: A giant serpent of the caves of the Richtersveld, said to have the strength of an elephant.

spells.name: Bearded Ogre's Trap
spells.story: A bearded cannibal ogre of Zulu tales, who lives in a hut in the veld and traps travellers.

spells.name: Bird-Woman's Call
spells.story: A bird-woman of the Maori tales, with a long beak, who chased the hero Hatupatu.

spells.name: Shark-Man's Bite
spells.story: A man by day with a shark's mouth on his back, who at night preyed on the bathers.

spells.name: Giant of the Reef
spells.story: The giant of the Melanesian tales who lies in wait in the sea and the cave.

spells.name: Giant's Tread
spells.source: Malagasy folklore (Sibree, The Great African Island)
spells.story: The old giant of the Malagasy tales, who watches the paths from the hills.

spells.name: Well Serpent
spells.story: The snake that kept the well of Daura, which a stranger from the east slew.

spells.name: Great Octopus
spells.story: The giant octopus of the Cook Strait, who defied the navigator Kupe.

spells.name: Tunis Rule
spells.story: The crafty ruler of the Taghribat epic, who plays tricks on the Hilali heroes.

spells.name: Tyrant's Rule
spells.story: The cruel chief of old Hawaii, who ruled harshly after his father's death.

spells.name: Runner's Chase
spells.story: The Maori hero who tricked the bird-woman and outran her pursuit; an honourable foe.

spells.name: Little Giant's Trick
spells.story: A little dwarf of the Malagasy tales, who tricks the giant into the pit.

spells.name: Swallower's Maw
spells.story: A giant creature of the Sotho tales, said to have swallowed the whole people and their cattle.

spells.name: Giant's Revenge
spells.story: The giant who killed Wahieroa, and whom the son Rata sought out.

spells.name: Queen Mother's Scheme
spells.story: The first queen of Mali in the epic, who plots to keep the rightful heir from the throne.

spells.name: Chief's Wrath
spells.story: The father in the Mwindo epic who casts out his son and sets his people against him.

spells.name: General's March
spells.story: A great general of the Mande tradition; an honourable foe with a respectful win line.

spells.name: Eel of Many Tides
spells.story: The great eel of Maori legend, whose body fills a river.

spells.name: Half-Brother's Exile
spells.story: The king of Mali who exiled his young half-brother and ruled in fear.

spells.name: Diyab's Charge
spells.story: A great warrior of the Hilali epic; an honourable foe with a respectful win line.

spells.name: Many-Headed Terror
spells.story: The many-headed monster of the Mwindo epic, which swallowed a whole village.

spells.name: Stone Body
spells.story: A warrior with a body of stone, who was only vulnerable in his shadow.

spells.name: Father's Blessing
spells.story: The king of Mali before Sundiata, who dies leaving his son the throne; an honourable foe.

spells.name: Rainbow Rule
spells.story: The tyrant king of the Luba legend, whose name means rainbow and whose rule was cruel.

spells.name: Buffalo-Woman's Might
spells.story: The mother of Sundiata in the epic, said to be the Buffalo-Woman of Do; an honourable foe.

spells.name: Old Hunter's Gift
spells.story: The old hunter of the Zulu tales; an honourable foe with a respectful win line.

spells.name: Avenger's Blow
spells.story: The young hero of the Maori tales who avenged his brother; an honourable foe.

spells.name: Stranger's Sword
spells.story: The stranger who slew the serpent of the well and wed the queen of Daura; an honourable foe.

spells.name: Buffalo Woman's Charge
spells.story: The great buffalo of Do that ravaged the land in the Sundiata epic, until hunters brought it down.

spells.name: Smith-General's Hammer
spells.story: The smith and general of Sosso, who first stood against Sundiata and then joined him.

spells.name: Founder's Landing
spells.story: The legendary first chief who sailed to Rapa Nui; an honourable foe with a respectful win line.

spells.name: Navigator's Wake
spells.story: The Maori navigator who crossed the sea and drove off the octopus; an honourable foe.

spells.name: Mutapa's Conquest
spells.story: The son of Mutota who spread the Mutapa kingdom to the sea in the fifteenth century; an honourable foe.

spells.name: Reef Maiden's Song
spells.story: A sea-maiden of the Napier reef, who left the reef to visit her land-lover and went back.

spells.name: Canoe-Builder's Axe
spells.story: The Maori hero who felled a tree and built his canoe to avenge his father; an honourable foe.

spells.name: Sorcerer-King's Rule
spells.story: The Susu king and sorcerer who ruled the old kingdom of Sosso; Sundiata's great opponent.

spells.name: Hilali's Cunning
spells.story: The cunning hero of the Hilali epic; an honourable foe with a respectful win line.

spells.name: Griot's Praise
spells.story: The griot of Sundiata who sang the hero's praise; the player stands against a bard, and the win line is respectful.

spells.name: Lute's Lament
spells.story: The hero of the Dausi who longed for a lute and lost his sons for it; a tragic hero whose win line is respectful.

spells.name: Founder's Spear
spells.story: The hero who overthrew the rainbow king and founded the Luba kingdom; an honourable foe.

spells.name: Liloa's Rule
spells.story: A great chief of old Hawaii, remembered for his fair rule; an honourable foe.

spells.name: Poet's Arrow
spells.story: The poet-hero of the Swahili coast, known for his bow and his verse; an honourable foe.

spells.name: Sakura's Pilgrimage
spells.story: The Mali emperor who conquered Gao and died on the way home from the pilgrimage.

spells.name: Mutapa's March
spells.story: The founder of the Mutapa kingdom who marched north from Great Zimbabwe in the fifteenth century.

spells.name: Queen of the Well
spells.story: The legendary queen of Daura who ruled the well; an honourable foe with a respectful win line.

spells.name: Ibonia's Quest
spells.story: The hero of the Malagasy epic who sought his bride against every foe; an honourable foe.

spells.name: Founder of Kongo
spells.story: The traditional founder of the Kongo kingdom, said to have crossed the river and ruled from Mbanza; an honourable foe.

spells.name: Golden Pilgrimage
spells.story: The Mali emperor of the fourteenth century whose gold astonished Cairo; an honourable foe with a respectful win line.

spells.name: Little-One's Tread
spells.story: The hero of the Nyanga epic, born walking and talking; an honourable foe with a respectful win line.

spells.name: Rumfa's Court
spells.story: The fifteenth-century king of Kano, remembered for his palace and his reforms; an honourable foe.

spells.name: Lion of Mali
spells.story: The founder of the Mali empire who stood up from his mother's hut and beat Sosso; an honourable foe with a respectful win line.

spells.name: Tin Hinan's Tent
spells.story: The ancestral queen of the Tuareg, said to have come to the Hoggar with her maid; an honourable foe.
